changed: Packing no longer prints ×1 beside every single item.
An item with no weight shows a dash in the editor, as it does everywhere else.
Folder names on a shared list are headings, so a screen reader can move between them.
The keyboard focus ring on a unit menu no longer touches the number beside it.
fixed: An item whose weight already reads the same as the catalog's no longer shows a Catalog note under it.
On a shared list, a group's name is no longer a web-search link.
A screen reader now hears which item or folder each row button belongs to.
